newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares seen starting firm.
newsitem.headline: French shares seen starting firm.

text.p: French shares were expected to start higher, buoyed by the Dow's 80-point rise overnight, despite June unemployment statistics seen on the high side, traders said.

"I think the opening will be good despite the unemployment figures," said a broker. But the market was unlikey to rise as strongly as yesterday, he added. Investors are looking to buy blue chips as major bourses ride the present bull run.
* CAC-40 index closed up 1.51 percent at 3,069.30 on Wednesday marking a new closing high.
* CAC-40 July futures on GLOBEX 3,080 vs 3,076 at Wednesdays close.
